result.summary: Fixed both @spec defects REVIEWER flagged in lib/letflow/repository.ex. Re-traced the reachable error paths myself against the current file state (did not just trust REVIEWER's line numbers) before editing: (1) create/2's `with` chain (lines 105-119) calls TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1, which returns {:error, :invalid_schema_name} on failure (confirmed lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex:193-208) -- added to create/2's @spec. create_with_retries/7's zero-retries clause (line 122-124) returns {:error, :version_number_conflict} directly -- added to create/2's @spec. (2) list_versions/4's `with` chain also calls tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 (same :invalid_schema_name path) -- added. It also calls Pagination.validate_page_size/1, which returns {:error, :page_size_too_large} (confirmed lib/letflow/api/pagination.ex:144-155), never :invalid_page_size as the prior @spec incorrectly claimed -- corrected. Verified the three cursor-decode errors already in the spec (:wrong_endpoint, :expired, :invalid_cursor) against decode_list_versions_cursor/1 (lines 271-284) -- these were already correct and unchanged. No function body touched; git diff confirms only the two @spec type signatures changed.
files_modified: lib/letflow/repository.ex (create/2 @spec: added {:error, :invalid_schema_name} and {:error, :version_number_conflict}; list_versions/4 @spec: added {:error, :invalid_schema_name}, corrected {:error, :invalid_page_size} to the real atom {:error, :page_size_too_large})
